Burgundy Asset Management Ltd decreased its stake in Bb&T Corp. (BBT) by 1.43% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd sold 120,223 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.68% with the market. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd who had been investing in Bb&T Corp. for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $42.41B market cap company. The stock increased 2.01% or $1.07 $54.39. Burgundy Asset Management Ltd, which manages about $19.85B and $10.67B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Houghton Mifflin Harcourt Co. (NASDAQ:HMHC) by 1.78 million shares to 6.50 million shares, valued at $45.16M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Berkshire Hathaway Inc. (BRKA) by 17 shares in the quarter, for a total of 362 shares, and has risen its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Analysts await BB&T Corporation (NYSE:BBT) to report earnings on July, 19. They expect $1.01 earnings per share, up 29.49 % or $0.23 from last year’s $0.78 per share. After $0.97 actual earnings per share reported by BB&T Corporation for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 4.12 % EPS growth.
